messages:
lina: FYI pushed a docs PR that consolidates rate-limit examples, updates the pricing snippet, and fixes two dashboard links. Would love quick reviews before Tue deploy.
alex: Can you drop the PR link? I'll skim the pricing bits. :eyes: 
lina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — main changes in /guides/rate-limits.md and /reference/pricing.md
sam: I'll check the SDK snippet for header examples. Noted there's a migration callout missing for SDK v5->v6.
lina: Good catch. I left a TODO in the PR to add a migration note and an example for the new "X-Redwood-Tier" header. Example in PR:
```
# python snippet (sdk v6)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=MY_KEY, tier='pro')
resp = c.generate("summarize this...", headers={"X-Redwood-Tier":"pro"})
```
alex: Also we should add a redirect note from /pricing/tiers -> /reference/pricing to avoid broken links from older blog posts.
michael: I can validate the Grafana panels — the two links looked stale because of a rename in the query id. Replacing panel 7's url param with panelId=21 fixed the dashboard render locally.
kevin: Pricing example needs an explicit per-embedding unit line (0.0008 per vector) and a worked example for a 1536-d embedding to avoid confusion.
sam: For the docs test, include a tiny unit test that asserts header mapping in the SDK snippet. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR for the test.
docs-bot: Checklist: 1) link fixes 2) code snippet lint 3) doc build successful on CI — pending
lina: CI is failing on the docs build because of a malformed anchor in /guides/rate-limits.md — small fix incoming.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2025-08-12 02:00 UTC if CI passes
alex: Once CI green, I'll approve. Thanks for consolidating these, lina.
lina: thanks all — tagging @michael @sam for follow-ups. will merge after CI + one more review. :thumbsup:
